verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS ATS like Lever, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST Data API, OAuth, webhooks and an integrator sandbox; it never mentions a first-party command-line tool. An API that a developer could wrap in a CLI is a building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
